rules.name: Fanatical Doctrines
rules.description:
Once per turn, at the start of any phase, each SAN'SHYUUM model from your army can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of it. That unit is affected by that Doctrine until the end of the turn. A unit can be affected by one Caste Doctrine and one Fanatical Doctrine at the same time. **Shielded by Faith:**
Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save. **Claim the Sacred Path:** Add 2 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit. **Wrath of the Prophets:** Weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Fevered Pilgrimage
rules.description: GRUNT units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance move.

rules.name: Devoted
rules.description: Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each UNGGOY Sergeant model from your army can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to its unit, as well as its Caste Doctrine. That Fanatical Doctrine lasts until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Invasion Vessels
rules.description: Spirit, Phantom and Lich units from your army are Invasion Vessels.

rules.name: Drop Assault
rules.description: Each time a unit disembarks from an Invasion Vessel that did not make an ingress move this turn, it can make an Assault Disembark move.

rules.name: Beachhead
rules.description: While a COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army is within 6" of an Invasion Vessel from your army, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Worthy Foe
rules.description:
At the start of each battle round, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the end of the battle round, that unit is your Worthy Foe.

Each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack that targets your Worthy Foe, add 1 to the wound roll.

rules.name: Shields of the Sangheili
rules.description:
Each time a SANGHEILI model from your army makes a Shield Save, re-roll a result of 1.

While a unit from your army contains one or more SANGHEILI models, add 1 to battle-shock rolls made for that unit.

Unbroken Discipline: Each time a SANGHEILI Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, that Doctrine lasts until the end of the turn instead of until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Bloodlust
rules.description: Each time a BRUTE unit from your army makes a charge move, until the end of the turn, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

rules.name: Pack Dominance
rules.description:
While a unit from your army contains one or more JIRALHANAE models, you can re-roll charge rolls made for that unit.

Alpha's Roar: Each JIRALHANAE Sergeant model from your army can issue one Caste Doctrine in each player's turn, instead of once per battle round.

rules.name: Chain of Command
rules.description:
Each battle round, each SANGHEILI Sergeant model from your army can issue up to 3 Caste Doctrines, and each JIRALHANAE Sergeant model up to 2.

Each Caste Doctrine is issued at the start of any phase, to the Sergeant model's own unit or to one friendly COVENANT unit of any kind (including VEHICLE and MOUNTED units) within 6" of it. That unit is affected by that Doctrine as though it contained that Sergeant model. A unit can still be affected by only one Caste Doctrine at a time.

rules.name: Combined Arms
rules.description:
Each unit's designation is its unit keyword: ELITE, BRUTE, GRUNT, JACKAL, DRONE, HUNTER or ENGINEER. VEHICLE and MOUNTED units have the VEHICLE designation instead. An Attached unit has the designations of all its units.

While a unit from your army is within 6" of a friendly unit with a designation it does not have, each time a model in it makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

rules.name: Plasma Overcharge
rules.description: Each time a COVENANT VEHICLE model from your army makes a ranged attack with a Plasma weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ scores a critical hit.

rules.name: Gravity Drives
rules.description: COVENANT VEHICLE units from your army are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move. Each time one of those units resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

rules.name: Separatists
rules.description: Your army cannot include JIRALHANAE or SAN'SHYUUM models, including Sergeant and Auxiliary models.

rules.name: Freed from the Lie
rules.description: Each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and re-roll a wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Brothers in Arms
rules.description: While a GRUNT unit from your army is within 6" of an ELITE unit from your army, each time a model in that GRUNT unit makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1, and add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that GRUNT unit.

rules.name: Pirates of the Void
rules.description:
​

**JACKAL units:**
Each time a model in a JACKAL unit from your army makes an attack that targets a unit below its starting strength, you can re-roll the hit roll. **Opportunists:**
Each time a YIG-YAR Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, select two of its Doctrines that can be used in that phase. Its unit is affected by both.

rules.name: The Hive Mind
rules.description:
​

**DRONE units:**
DRONE units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move. **Hive Link:**
Each time a YANME'E Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, select one other friendly DRONE unit within 12" of it. That unit is also affected by that Doctrine.

rules.name: Living Colony
rules.description:
​

**Colony Regeneration:**
At the start of your Command phase, each model in a HUNTER unit from your army heals D3. **Hunters of Machines:**
Each time a MGALEKGOLO model from your army makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, re-roll a wound roll of 1.

rules.name: Mending the Fleet
rules.description:
​

**ENGINEER units:**
Each time an ENGINEER model from your army uses Repair and Refit, it can select a friendly COVENANT unit with Shields within 3" of it instead of a VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION model. That unit regains D3+1 lost SP. **HURAGOK models:**
While a friendly COVENANT unit is within 3" of one or more HURAGOK models from your army, each time it resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains 1 additional lost SP.

rules.name: Strength in Numbers
rules.description:
​

**GRUNT units:**
While a GRUNT unit from your army contains 10 or more models, add 1 to the A characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit. **Mob Mentality:**
Each time an UNGGOY Sergeant model from your army issues a Caste Doctrine, every other friendly GRUNT unit within 6" of it is also affected by that Doctrine.

rules.name: Striding Siege
rules.description:
​

**WALKER units:**
COVENANT WALKER units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance move, and they can move over terrain features 4" or less in height as though they were not there. **Siege Weapons:**
Ranged weapons equipped by COVENANT WALKER models from your army have [IGNORES COVER].

rules.name: Wrath of the Hierarchs
rules.description:
​

**TITANIC units:**
COVENANT TITANIC models from your army ignore the hit-roll penalty of their Damaged ability, and each time one of them makes an attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. **Titan Shields:**
Each time a COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army resolves Regenerating Shields, it regains D3 additional lost SP.

rules.name: Shadow War
rules.description:
SPECIAL OPERATIONS, RANGER, ASSASSIN and BLADEMASTER units from your army are Spec Ops units. **Spec Ops units:**
Models in Spec Ops units from your army have the Stealth ability. **Every Blade a Shadowmaster:**
Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each Spec Ops INFANTRY unit from your army can issue one Sangheili Special Operations Doctrine to itself, as though it contained a Shadowmaster.

rules.name: The Hierarchs' Will
rules.description:
​

**SAN'SHYUUM models:**
Add 3" to the range of abilities of SAN'SHYUUM models from your army. **Sworn Protectors:**
While an HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army contains a CHARACTER model, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit, and its models have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

rules.name: Masters of the Sky
rules.description:
Banshee, Vampire and Seraph units from your army are Fleet Aviation units. **Air Superiority:**
Each time a model in a Fleet Aviation unit from your army makes a ranged attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1. If the target has the FLY keyword, you can re-roll the hit roll instead. **Strike and Withdraw:**
After a Fleet Aviation unit from your army has shot, if it is unengaged, it can make a normal move of up to 6".

rules.name: Lances of the Covenant
rules.description:
​

**MOUNTED units:**
COVENANT MOUNTED units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they made an advance or fall-back move. **Splatter:**
Each time a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army ends a charge move, select one enemy unit it is engaged with and roll one D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Caste Hierarchy
sharedRules.description:
​

**Sergeants:**
A Sergeant model's entry lists the Caste Doctrines it can issue. **Auxiliaries:**
A unit can include Auxiliary models at the rate printed on its datasheet (for example, for every 5 Unggoy Warriors, 1 Sangheili Auxiliary or up to 2 Yig-Yar Auxiliaries). There is one Auxiliary entry per species: Sangheili, Jiralhanae, Yig-Yar, T'vaoan, Unggoy, Huragok and Yanme'e. T'vaoan Auxiliaries have the YIG-YAR keyword, so they can be taken wherever Yig-Yar Auxiliaries can. A unit cannot include Auxiliary models of its own species: an ELITE unit cannot include Sangheili Auxiliaries, a GRUNT unit cannot include Unggoy Auxiliaries, a BRUTE unit cannot include Jiralhanae Auxiliaries, and so on (the Sangheili Special Operations Team is the exception). Each Auxiliary model can take one Specialist ability from its entry, at the points shown. **Keywords:**
As in the core rules, a unit has the keywords of all its models, including its Sergeant and Auxiliary models: a Sangheili Warrior Cadre with an Unggoy Auxiliary is also an UNGGOY unit. Each species' own datasheets also have a unit keyword that its Sergeant and Auxiliary models do not: GRUNT (Unggoy), ELITE (Sangheili), BRUTE (Jiralhanae), JACKAL (Yig-Yar and T'vaoan), DRONE (Yanme'e), HUNTER (Mgalekgolo) and ENGINEER (Huragok). Rules for those keywords affect only that species' units; rules for UNGGOY, SANGHEILI and the other species keywords affect any unit with such a model in it. **Toughness:**
A unit's T characteristic is the one that the most models in it have. If two or more are tied, use the lowest. **Issuing Caste Doctrines:**
Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, each Sergeant model from your army can issue one Caste Doctrine from its entry to its unit. Unless otherwise stated, a unit can be affected by only one Caste Doctrine at a time.

sharedRules.name: Shielding Trait
sharedRules.description:
A model with an SP characteristic has Shields and starts the battle with that many Shield Points (SP). **Shield Save:**
Each time a model with 1 or more SP fails a save roll, determine the attack's Damage, then roll one D6. ■ 3+: the shield absorbs the attack. Subtract its Damage from the model's SP instead of its wounds; any excess is inflicted on its wounds. ■ 1–2: the shield is bypassed. All of the attack's Damage is inflicted on the model's wounds and its SP are not reduced. **Regenerating Shields:**
At the start of your Command phase, each unit with Shields regains D3 lost SP (D3+1 for VEHICLE and MOUNTED units, unless its datasheet says otherwise), split between its models as you choose. No model can exceed its starting SP. **Damage That Ignores Shields:**
Damage from [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] and psychic attacks ignores SP.

sharedRules.name: Chosen of the Hierarchs
sharedRules.description: At the start of each battle round, if your WARLORD has this ability, gain 1CP.

sharedRules.name: Caste Doctrines
sharedRules.description:
​

**Sangheili Doctrines**
**Focused Assault:**
At the start of your Shooting or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit. **Sangheili Ambush:**
At the start of your Shooting or Fight phase, select one of the following effects until the end of the phase: weapons equipped by models in this unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; weapons equipped by models in this unit have [LETHAL HITS]; or unmodified hit rolls of 5+ made by models in this unit are critical hits. **Tactical Withdrawal:**
At the start of your Shooting or Charge phase, until the end of the phase, this unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge, respectively, in a turn in which it made a fall-back move. **Sangheili Special Operations Doctrines**
**Silent Approach:**
At the start of your Movement phase, until the end of the turn, this unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move, and enemy units cannot use Fire Overwatch against it. **Decapitation Strike:**
At the start of your Shooting or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, attacks made by models in this unit have [PRECISION]. When such an attack targets a CHARACTER unit, re-roll a wound roll of 1. **Fade Into Shadow:**
At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Stealth ability. **Jiralhanae Doctrines**
**Relentless Charge:**
At the start of your Charge phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit. **Savage Momentum:**
At the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the S characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit if this unit made a charge move this turn. **Unyielding Fury:**
At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase or at the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit. **Yig-Yar Doctrines**
**Pick Apart the Weak:**
At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for ranged attacks made by models in this unit that target a unit below starting strength or within range of an objective marker. **Fire and Scuttle:**
At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, after this unit has shot it can make a normal move of up to 6". If it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn. **Survival Above Honour:**
At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, this unit has Stealth and improve the Shield Save of models in it by 1, to a maximum of 2+. **Unggoy Doctrines**
**Desperate Survival:**
At the start of any phase, until the end of the phase, models in this unit have Feel No Pain 4+. **Vengeful Retaliation:**
At the start of the Shooting or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, each time a model in this unit is destroyed, before removing it roll one D6. On a 4+, it can shoot if destroyed in the Shooting phase, or fight if destroyed in the Fight phase and it has not fought. Remove it after resolving those attacks. **Courage Through Fear:**
At the start of any phase, until the end of the phase, improve this unit's Ld characteristic by 2 and re-roll battle-shock rolls made for it. **Yanme'e Doctrines**
**Swarm Convergence:**
At the start of your Shooting or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by models in this unit while it contains 5 or more models. **Predatory Descent:**
At the start of your Charge or Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 1 to charge rolls made for this unit and melee weapons equipped by its models have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. **Fade Into Shadow:**
At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, this unit has the Stealth ability.

sharedRules.name: Supercombine
sharedRules.description: After this unit has made its hit rolls, for every three hits scored against the same target with [SUPERCOMBINE] weapons, that target suffers 1 mortal wound. Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] count.

sharedRules.name: Plasma
sharedRules.description: Each time an attack made with a Plasma weapon scores a critical hit, add X to that attack's D characteristic if the weapon has Plasma (DX), or improve that attack's AP characteristic by X if it has Plasma (APX). For example, a critical hit with a Plasma (AP1) weapon improves that attack's AP by 1. Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] do not benefit.

sharedRules.name: Conversion
sharedRules.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon targets a unit more than 12" from the bearer, an unmodified successful hit roll of 4+ scores a critical hit.

sharedRules.name: Gravity Slam
sharedRules.description: Once per phase, when a unit containing one or more models equipped with this weapon is selected to fight, before it makes its attacks, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 3" of one or more of those models. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and must make a battle-shock roll.

sharedRules.name: Siegebreaker
sharedRules.description: Each time an attack made with this weapon scores a critical hit, invulnerable saves cannot be used against that attack. Extra hits from [SUSTAINED HITS] do not benefit.

sharedRules.name: Wargear Costs
sharedRules.description: Weapon exchanges are free, except: Fuel Rod, Skewer, two Needlers, Gravity Hammer and Twin-linked Energy Swords (+10 pts each) and Wrist Shield (+5 pts). A datasheet's own limits and costs take precedence.

sharedRules.name: Transport Space
sharedRules.description:
Each model takes up the following Transport Space:

■ INFANTRY: 1
■ HUNTER INFANTRY: 5
■ MOUNTED: 4
■ VEHICLE: 8

A TRANSPORT whose capacity is given in Transport Space can carry any mix of eligible models up to that total, within the limits on its datasheet. AIRCRAFT, TITANIC and TRANSPORT VEHICLE models cannot be carried unless a datasheet says otherwise.

sharedRules.name: Frame
sharedRules.description: Core rules 17.02. Whenever a rule refers to a FRAME model's position relative to anything else on the battlefield, such as when measuring distances, measure to and from the closest point of that model, not necessarily its base. When a FRAME model without a base rotates as part of a move, turn it any amount around its central axis, keeping it upright.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Proclaim the Sacred Path / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase, just after a SAN'SHYUUM model from your army issues a Fanatical Doctrine. **Target**
That SAN'SHYUUM model's unit. **Effect**
Select one more friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of that model. That unit is also affected by that Doctrine until the end of the turn.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Cleanse the Sacred Ground / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a GRUNT unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Armoured by Conviction / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Martyr's Zeal / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, roll one D6. On a 5+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Living Bulwark / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one non-CHARACTER GRUNT unit from your army within 3" of it. **Effect**
Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if your GRUNT unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your GRUNT unit instead.

sharedRules.name: The Great Journey — Unquestioning Obedience / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Just after a GRUNT unit from your army within 6" of a SAN'SHYUUM model from your army fails a battle-shock roll. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and that battle-shock roll is treated as passed.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Hot Drop / 2 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just before a unit from your army disembarks from an Invasion Vessel that made an ingress move this turn. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make an Assault Disembark move.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Gravity-Lift Insertion / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army makes an advance move. **Target**
One unit embarked within that Invasion Vessel. **Effect**
Your unit can make a Shock Disembark move from it this phase.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Strafing Run / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army makes a normal or advance move. **Target**
That Invasion Vessel. **Effect**
Select one enemy unit that your unit moved over during that move. Roll six D6 (twelve D6 if your unit is a Lich): for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Return to the Fleet / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of the Fight phase. **Target**
One unengaged COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army with every model within 3" of an Invasion Vessel from your army. **Effect**
If that Invasion Vessel has enough transport capacity, your unit embarks within it, even if your unit disembarked this turn.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Hold the Beachhead / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 6" of an Invasion Vessel from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT INFANTRY unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Clear the Landing Zone / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an Invasion Vessel from your army, or a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of one, is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Fleetborne Invasion — Glassing Beam / 2 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One Sangheili Shipmaster model from your army. **Effect**
Your fleet answers the Shipmaster's call. Select one enemy unit within 48" of and visible to your model, then roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers 3D6 mortal wounds. **Restrictions**
You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — The Killing Stroke / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army is selected to fight. **Target**
That ELITE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS], and each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets your Worthy Foe, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Shields Unbroken / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a unit from your army that contains one or more SANGHEILI models as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for SANGHEILI models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Relentless Pursuit / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army makes an advance move. **Target**
That ELITE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Honour Duel / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Epic Deed Stratagem* **When**
Start of the Fight phase. **Target**
One SANGHEILI CHARACTER unit from your army that is engaged with one or more enemy CHARACTER units. **Effect**
Select one SANGHEILI CHARACTER model in your unit and one CHARACTER model in an enemy unit your unit is engaged with. Until both models have fought or either is destroyed, each can only make melee attacks that target the other's unit, those attacks can only be allocated to the other model, and attacks made by other models cannot be allocated to either of them. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by your model.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Death Before Dishonour / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects an ELITE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That ELITE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it. After the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, that model can fight, and is then removed.

sharedRules.name: Sangheili Warhost — Command the Lesser Races / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase. **Target**
One unit from your army whose SANGHEILI Sergeant model has already issued a Caste Doctrine this battle round. **Effect**
That Sergeant model can issue one more Caste Doctrine this battle round. If your unit is already affected by a Caste Doctrine, the new Doctrine replaces it.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Pin the Prey / 2 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Movement phase. **Target**
One unengaged BRUTE INFANTRY or BRUTE MOUNTED unit from your army within 12" of one or more enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase. **Effect**
Resolve a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Crushing Assault / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a BRUTE unit from your army is selected to fight. **Target**
That BRUTE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll. If your unit is below its starting strength, also add 1 to the hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Unbreakable Hide / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a unit from your army that contains one or more JIRALHANAE models as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack is allocated to a JIRALHANAE model in your unit, worsen the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Hold Them Fast / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit engaged with one or more BRUTE units from your army is selected to make a fall-back move. **Target**
One of those BRUTE units. **Effect**
That enemy unit must make a Desperate Escape test.

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Brutal Momentum / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a BRUTE unit from your army destroys an enemy unit. **Target**
That BRUTE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, when your unit makes a consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of 3".

sharedRules.name: Jiralhanae Warpack — Pack Alpha's Fury / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase. **Target**
One unit from your army whose JIRALHANAE Sergeant model has already issued a Caste Doctrine this turn. **Effect**
That Sergeant model can issue one more Caste Doctrine this turn. If your unit is already affected by a Caste Doctrine, the new Doctrine replaces it.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Coordinated Strike / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a unit from your army has shot. **Target**
One enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks, and one other unit from your army that has a designation the first unit does not have and has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that other unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Armoured Escort / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a unit from your army within 6" of a friendly unit with the VEHICLE designation as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, your unit has the benefit of cover.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Extended Command Net / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase. **Target**
One unit from your army that contains a Sergeant model. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, that Sergeant model can issue Caste Doctrines to units within 12" of it instead of 6".

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Joint Assault / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a unit from your army is selected to fight. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack that targets an enemy unit that is also engaged with a friendly unit with a designation your unit does not have, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Shield Relay / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army with Shields and one COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 6" of it. **Effect**
Your VEHICLE unit loses up to 3 SP. Your INFANTRY unit regains that many lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Covenant Expeditionary Force — Combined Assault / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Charge phase, just after a unit from your army ends a charge move. **Target**
One other unit from your army with a designation that unit does not have, that has not declared a charge this phase. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, if your unit declares a charge against an enemy unit engaged with the first unit, you can re-roll its charge roll.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Overcharged Cannons / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the S and D characteristics of Plasma weapons equipped by models in your unit. After your unit has shot, each model in it loses D3 SP.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Target Lock / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Gravity Surge / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after an unengaged COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army has shot. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Ramming Speed / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Charge phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army ends a charge move. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Select one enemy unit your unit is engaged with and roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Reinforced Armour / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Armored Spearhead — Emergency Shield Reroute / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the SP of a COVENANT VEHICLE model from your army is reduced to 0. **Target**
That model's unit. **Effect**
That model regains D3+1 lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — For Sanghelios! / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an ELITE unit from your army is selected to fight. **Target**
That ELITE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — Shoulder to Shoulder / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a GRUNT unit from your army within 6" of an ELITE unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — Active Camouflage / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an ELITE INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That ELITE unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, models in your unit have the Stealth ability.

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — Avenge the Fallen / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Just after an ELITE unit from your army is destroyed. **Target**
The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect**
Until the end of your next turn, each time a model in an ELITE unit from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, you can re-roll the hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — Rally the Swords / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One battle-shocked GRUNT or ELITE unit from your army within 6" of a SANGHEILI CHARACTER model from your army. **Effect**
Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

sharedRules.name: Swords of Sanghelios — Plasma Grenades / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase. **Target**
One ELITE or GRUNT GRENADES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase. **Effect**
Select one enemy unit within 8" of and visible to your unit, and roll six D6. For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Your unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Scuttle to Cover / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making attacks against an unengaged JACKAL unit from your army. **Target**
That JACKAL unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6".

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Pick Them Off / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a JACKAL unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That JACKAL unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [PRECISION], and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Yig-Yar Hunting Talon — Shield Wall / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a JACKAL INFANTRY unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That JACKAL unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Endless Hive / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One DRONE unit from your army that is below its starting strength. **Effect**
Your unit heals D3+1.

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Needler Storm / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a DRONE unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That DRONE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

sharedRules.name: Drone Hive Swarm — Take to the Skies / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Fight phase. **Target**
One unengaged DRONE unit from your army. **Effect**
Place your unit into strategic reserves.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Bond-Brother's Vengeance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a MGALEKGOLO model from your army is destroyed. **Target**
That model's unit. **Effect**
Before removing that model, it can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase if it was destroyed in the Shooting phase, or fight if it was destroyed in the Fight phase.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Unstoppable Advance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a HUNTER unit from your army makes an advance move. **Target**
That HUNTER unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

sharedRules.name: Bonded Colony — Colony Guardians / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT CHARACTER unit from your army within 3" of a HUNTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That CHARACTER unit and that HUNTER unit. **Effect**
Each time one of those attacks targets your CHARACTER unit, if your HUNTER unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your HUNTER unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Emergency Restoration / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has finished making attacks against a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army. **Target**
That COVENANT unit. **Effect**
Your unit regains D3 lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Harmonised Shields / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That COVENANT unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

sharedRules.name: Engineer Reclamation Detail — Overcharged Systems / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of an ENGINEER model from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That VEHICLE unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for ranged attacks made by models in your unit. After your unit has shot, each model in it loses D3 SP.

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — Expendable Screen / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a non-GRUNT COVENANT INFANTRY unit from your army within 3" of a GRUNT unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That INFANTRY unit and that GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Each time one of those attacks targets your INFANTRY unit, if your GRUNT unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets your GRUNT unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — Reinforce the Levy / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Command phase. **Target**
One Grunt Cadre unit from your army that is below its starting strength. **Effect**
Your unit heals D3+2.

sharedRules.name: Grunt Levy — Grenade Rush / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Charge phase, just after a GRUNT unit from your army ends a charge move. **Target**
That GRUNT unit. **Effect**
Select one enemy unit your unit is engaged with, and roll one D6 for each model in your unit, to a maximum of 10. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

sharedRules.name: Siege Engines — Crushing Stride / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army makes a normal or advance move. **Target**
That WALKER unit. **Effect**
Select one enemy INFANTRY unit within 3" of your unit, and roll six D6. For each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

sharedRules.name: Siege Engines — Siege Stance / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army that remained stationary this turn is selected to shoot. **Target**
That WALKER unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

sharedRules.name: Siege Engines — Overshield Projectors / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT WALKER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That WALKER unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time one of those attacks targets your unit, if its S characteristic is greater than the T characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Engines of Purification — Glassing Strike / 2 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That TITANIC unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

sharedRules.name: Engines of Purification — Unstoppable Behemoth / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Movement phase, just after an engaged COVENANT TITANIC unit from your army is selected to make a fall-back move. **Target**
That TITANIC unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made a fall-back move.

sharedRules.name: Engines of Purification — Emergency Shield Surge / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Wargear Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after the SP of a COVENANT TITANIC model from your army is reduced to 0. **Target**
That model's unit. **Effect**
That model regains D6 lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Special Operations — Booby Trap / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Movement phase. **Target**
One enemy unit within 6" of a Spec Ops unit from your army. **Effect**
Roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

sharedRules.name: Special Operations — Vanish / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's Fight phase. **Target**
One unengaged Spec Ops INFANTRY unit from your army. **Effect**
Place your unit into strategic reserves.

sharedRules.name: Special Operations — Decapitate / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Spec Ops unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight. **Target**
That Spec Ops unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [PRECISION], and each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Hierarchs' Court — Protect the Hierarch / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army within 3" of it. **Effect**
Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if your HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit is an eligible target for that attack, it targets that unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Hierarchs' Court — Holy Decree / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Start of any phase. **Target**
One SAN'SHYUUM model from your army. **Effect**
Select one friendly COVENANT unit within 12" of that model and one Caste Doctrine that can be used in that phase. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by that Doctrine.

sharedRules.name: Hierarchs' Court — Divine Retribution / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after an HONOR GUARD or ENTOURAGE unit from your army within 6" of a SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER model from your army is selected to fight. **Target**
That unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the hit roll and add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Fleet Aviation — Strafing Pass / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a Fleet Aviation unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That Fleet Aviation unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit without the FLY keyword, that attack has [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

sharedRules.name: Fleet Aviation — Dogfight / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after a Fleet Aviation unit from your army is selected to shoot. **Target**
That Fleet Aviation unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a unit with the FLY keyword, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Fleet Aviation — Return to the Carrier / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
End of your opponent's turn. **Target**
One Fleet Aviation unit from your army. **Effect**
Place your unit into strategic reserves. Each model in it regains all of its lost SP.

sharedRules.name: Ghost Lances — Ride Them Down / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Battle Tactic Stratagem* **When**
Fight phase, just after a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight. **Target**
That MOUNTED unit. **Effect**
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the wound roll.

sharedRules.name: Ghost Lances — Hit and Fade / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your Shooting phase, just after an unengaged COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army has shot. **Target**
That MOUNTED unit. **Effect**
Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6". It is not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

sharedRules.name: Ghost Lances — Evasive Boost / 1 CP
sharedRules.description:
*Strategic Ploy Stratagem* **When**
Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a COVENANT MOUNTED unit from your army as the target of one or more attacks. **Target**
That MOUNTED unit. **Effect**
Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.
